name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou (Czechia)
description: Quartered yellow and blue, with the hoist quarters narrower than the fly quarters.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 15 June 2015 (decision No. 35) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
